prompt:
Design and implement the brownfield workload-domain migration architecture for the VCF estate in fixtures/estate.json. The existing management domain must remain at its recorded versions and must not be modified. The standalone workload environment must become the new VI workload domain at the target release without any unsupported version hop.

Before designing or coding, research Broadcom's currently published VMware Cloud Foundation compatibility and BOM material, Product Interoperability Matrix material, and upgrade and import documentation. Establish that every source-to-target combination and hop selected is supported. Record the title, URL, access date, and the decision supported by each source consulted in RESEARCH.md.

Produce migration-plan.json as the architecture artifact. It must conform to the SddcSpec schema in the VMware Cloud Foundation Installer API 9.1.0.0 contract and satisfy the migration-specific schema in schemas/migration-plan.schema.json. The same top-level JSON object is both the installer-shaped target description and the ordered migration plan; do not wrap the SddcSpec in another field. Name every component in the estate fixture exactly once with its current version, target version, disposition, and technical gates. Give the ordered transition steps, exact from/to versions, actions, required gates, and gates produced. Preserve every management-domain component unchanged.

Implement package migrationplan at the repository root using the standard library. Provide the JSON-backed types Plan, Component, Gate, Step, Transition, Estate, EstateComponent, and SupportedTransition. Provide DecodePlan(io.Reader) (Plan, error), DecodeEstate(io.Reader) (Estate, error), and Validate(Plan, Estate) error. Decoders must reject malformed JSON, unknown fields, and trailing JSON values. Validate must enforce installer-target identity, complete and unique inventory coverage, immutable management-domain versions, supported component targets and transitions, complete technical gates, strictly increasing unique step order, transition coverage exactly once, and prerequisite/produced-gate ordering. Return descriptive errors rather than panicking.

Run go test -race -timeout 30s ./.... architecture_test.go, fixtures/, schemas/, and specifications/ must not be changed.
